name: Kunduz

queries.query: Kunduz Afghanistan official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS Ministry of Agriculture land authority
queries.result: Official Afghanistan National Portal, MAIL and MUDH results identified Kunduz land-registration, property-rights verification and cadastral-survey activity. The public PRMIS/MIS shell and official pages did not expose an anonymous parcel feature service with a stable safe ID and geometry.

queries.query: کادستر نقشه ثبت ملکیت زمین کندز اداره اراضی افغانستان
queries.result: Official MAIL Dari/Pashto pages document a Kunduz property-rights verification center, provincial cadastral survey work and cadastral maps/sketches in Kunduz cases. No public anonymous parcel geometry endpoint or safe native parcel ID response was found.

registryBasis: First-party MAIL pages identify the provincial land/agriculture authority and a Kunduz property-rights verification center; official Kunduz case reports explicitly reference cadastral maps, cadastral pieces, coordinates and sketches. This evidences a local/provincial cadastral or land-registry custodian, not an open parcel API.
